first_run_notice: Campus material is for your personal use as an enrolled student. Do not share or publish it: it may be protected by copyright.
login_steps:
1. Press “Open browser” and log in to your campus as usual.
2. When the browser asks whether to open Aulari, accept.
3. This window will continue by itself.
logout_done: The token has been deleted from this computer. The campus offers no way to revoke it: it stays valid until it expires. If you think someone copied it, tell your campus support.
courses_new: There are new courses. Tick them if you want to download them.
summary_missing: Deleted by you from the folder: {count} (press “Recover deleted” to download them again)
calendar_error: The calendar could not be exported: {error}
error_invalid_token: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
error_locked: A sync is already running in this folder. If not, delete the file {path}.
error_not_owner: This folder is synced by another computer ({host}). Do you want this computer to take over?
error_no_year: The campus address does not include the academic year (for example, /2026-27).
error_network: Could not connect to the campus ({error}). Check your connection and try again.
login_need_browser_first: Press “Open browser” first: each login needs a new address.
login_invalid_redirect: The pasted address is not valid or belongs to another attempt. Press “Open browser” and start again.
error_locked_short: A sync is already running in this folder.
error_moodle: The campus answered with an error: {error}
error_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Details are in the application log.
error_config_corrupt: The settings file is damaged. Delete or rename it (it is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\aulari\config.json) and open the application again.
error_keyring: Could not access the Windows credential store.
login_waiting: Waiting for the browser… Log in and accept “Open Aulari” when asked.
login_timeout: Stopped waiting for the browser. Press “Open browser” to try again.
login_auto_unavailable: Automatic login is not available on this computer. Use the manual option.
login_manual_steps: Only if the automatic option does not work: in the browser, open the developer tools (F12) > Network > “Preserve log” before pressing “Open browser”. When done, in the “launch.php” request, copy the value of the “Location” header (it starts with moodlemobile://) and paste it here.
login_steps_macos: Automatic login on a Mac only works with the installed app (Aulari.app) when it is the app that opens moodlemobile:// links. That is not the case here: follow the steps below.
login_manual_steps_macos:
With Google Chrome or another Chromium-based browser (Arc, Edge, Brave):
1. Open a new tab, press ⌘⌥I, go to Network and tick “Preserve log”.
2. Press “Copy login address” and paste the address into that tab.
3. Log in if asked. At the end the page stays blank or stuck: that is expected.
4. Type launch.php in the filter, open the request with status 302 and, under “Response Headers”, copy the value of “Location” (it starts with moodlemobile://).
5. Paste it here and press “Log in”.
Each press of the button starts a new attempt: always use the last address copied.
login_copied: Address copied. Paste it into the tab whose developer tools are open.
callback_no_app: Open Aulari, press “Open browser” and log in again.
courses_none: No courses were found on this campus.
sync_cancelling: Cancelling: it will stop after the current file…
summary_more_errors: … and {count} more errors (details in the log).
error_alias_invalid: That folder name is not valid.
error_alias_not_synced: Sync the course once before changing its folder.
error_alias_taken: There is already another folder with that name in this academic year.
year_folder_prompt: Folder name for the {year} academic year (for example, “Year 2”). Leave it empty to go back to “{year}”:
year_folder_done: The academic year folder is now “{name}”.
subfolder_prompt: Name of the subfolder for the campus material inside each course (for example, “Campus”). Leave it empty for none. Your own folders are not moved:
subfolder_done: The campus material now goes to “{name}” inside each course.
subfolder_off: The campus material now goes straight into each course folder.
error_folder_invalid: That folder name is not valid.
error_folder_taken: There is already a folder with that name. Nothing was moved.
space_style_confirm: Every section folder and file Aulari downloaded will be renamed, in every academic year. Your own folders and the names you typed do not change. Continue?
space_style_done: The downloaded material has been renamed.
error_names_taken: A new name already exists. Nothing was changed.
deadlines_none: No deadlines in the coming weeks.
deadlines_unavailable: The dates could not be loaded.
course_folder_missing: This course's folder does not exist yet: sync it first.
news_none: No new items yet: they will appear after a sync with new files.
announcements_error: The announcements could not be checked: {error}
announcements_notice: There are {count} new announcements in your courses. Do you want to see them now?
announcements_none: No new announcements since the last sync.
table_double_click_hint: Double-click a course to see the details.
add_site_prompt: Campus address of the other academic year:
remove_site_confirm: Remove the academic year {site} from the application? Its session will be deleted from this computer; downloaded files are not touched.
error_site_exists: That academic year is already in the list.
error_site_unknown: That academic year is not in the list.
site_skipped_no_session: Not logged in: open this year and log in.
auto_sync_on: Automatic sync on ({label}, and when Windows starts).
error_scheduler: Could not set up the Windows Task Scheduler.
notice_title: Aulari: there is news in your campus.
notice_session_expired: The session of year {site} has expired: open Aulari and log in.
